title: Build an IVR without a server
summary: A call flow is a SWML document you hand to the platform, so no server of yours serves it. The spec calls relayml the document the flow should execute. One POST creates the flow from a title, a relayml document and the flow_data the spec pairs with it. One POST points a number at it by phone_route_id with the calling handler.
scenario: A bike shop that wants press 1 for sales, 2 for the workshop on its main number and nothing to keep running

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/resources/call_flows: title required, relayml the calling SWML document, flow_data optional
tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/fabric/resources/{id}/phone_routes: phone_route_id and handler required
schema.json Prompt (play required, max_digits), Switch (variable, case); prompt_value holds the digits
